- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet photo validation stage: Insert a dedicated photo clarity verification screen before certificate generation to prevent custom pet visual glitches or setup failures. (why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or results in distorted visual renders.)
1: [finish, redesign] Stage layout for home introduction: Redesign the home_intro screen into a stage layout emphasizing key desktop controls and interaction shortcuts. (why: Finish step conversion dropped to 64.8% with 5815s mean time, and 3 support tickets noted confusion over controlling or hiding the pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering pipeline explanation notice: Display step-by-step rendering engine startup notices on the waiting screen while the pet initializes on screen. (why: Home waiting screen shows a long mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Multi-device pet save reassurance text: Update the sign-in prompt body text to explicitly clarify that logging in preserves pet progress across reinstallations and device changes. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) involved missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path selection flexibility hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that choosing a premade path does not prevent users from making custom pets later. (why: Choose_path step has a 514s mean duration, indicating user hesitation about path commitment.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split layout for adoption certificate screen: Switch adoption certificate layout to split view, presenting companion stats side-by-side with certificate details. (why: Adoption conversion is 74.5% with high median completion time (89s).)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop notification toggle on final view: Enable a desktop notification toggle on the finish screen so users stay alerted when their desktop pet needs care. (why: 4 support emails complained about desktop feature misbehavior or missing notifications after setup.)
